name: std::basic_streambuf<CharT,Traits>::sbumpc, std::basic_streambuf<CharT,Traits>::stossc
intro:
Reads one character and advances the input sequence by one character.

1) If the input sequence read position is not available, returns uflow(). Otherwise returns Traits::to_int_type(*gptr()).

2) Same as (1), but discards the result.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: 1) The value of the character pointed to by the get pointer, or Traits::eof() if the read position is not available.

examples.title: Practical use case
examples.input: Run the self-contained program; assertions check the documented behavior.
